free_tier.stated: 100 GB total storage per organization on Starter (Free); 250 MB single-file limit for Docs uploads on Starter

egress.terms: Downloads served from Lark CDN (ByteDance edge) at no metered charge; download via OpenAPI media download returns a signed URL, no per-GB line item anywhere in the plan table

tooling: Official OpenAPI v3 drive endpoints (upload_all for <=20MB, multipart upload of 4MB chunks above that) + first-party CLI larksuite/cli (17,762 stars, pushed 2026-10-21) with `lark-cli drive +upload`; no rclone backend
chaining: 100 GB x N free organizations. Starter is self-serve per organization and the quota is per-org, not per-user, so N disposable orgs = N x 100 GB. Paid Basic (5 TB) shows the ceiling is only billing, not architecture.
limits_note: 250 MB per file for Docs on Starter (vs 50 GB on Pro); upload_all hard-caps at 20 MB by design, must use multipart; 5 QPS on upload_all; 4 MB fixed chunk size on multipart; upload transaction ID valid 1 day for resume
reliability_note: Rate limits are explicit (5 QPS on single upload) and multipart is resumable, but Starter orgs that lapse back from a paid plan are force-collapsed to Starter member and storage caps - data above 100 GB becomes unwritable, not deleted.
